text.en: Daniel's photography and travels. Welcome in.
text.zh: Daniel 的摄影与旅行，欢迎进来。

text.en: Sony A7R2. Film and digital. Dark gold palette. This site has opinions.
text.zh: A7R2，胶片加数码，暗金配色。这个网站很有主见。

text.en: Photography, an interactive map, travel itineraries. Explore at will.
text.zh: 摄影集、交互地图、旅行行程，随便逛。

text.en: Film nostalgia and digital clarity in the same portfolio.
text.zh: 胶片的怀旧感和数码的清晰度，同一个作品集里。

text.en: Welcome. The photos are better looking than I am.
text.zh: 欢迎。照片比我好看多了。

text.en: I wonder which section pulls you first.
text.zh: 我好奇你会先被哪个版块吸引。

text.en: Dark aesthetic. Very deliberate.
text.zh: 暗调美学，非常有目的性。

text.en: The travel itineraries here are real. The photos too.
text.zh: 这里的旅行行程是真实的，照片也是。

text.en: Taking it in. That shot deserves the pause.
text.zh: 慢慢看，那张照片值得停一下。

text.en: Deciding which city feels most like you?
text.zh: 在想哪座城市最像你？

text.en: Film photos reward slow looking.
text.zh: 胶片照片，慢慢看才有味道。

text.en: No rush. Paris will still be there.
text.zh: 不急，巴黎又跑不掉。

text.en: The itinerary has this effect on people.
text.zh: 行程表就是有这种让人发呆的魔力。

text.en: Good light in a photo takes time to notice.
text.zh: 照片里好的光线，需要时间才能察觉。

text.en: I'll float here politely while you think.
text.zh: 你在思考，我就礼貌地飘着。

text.en: Time moves differently in front of a good photograph.
text.zh: 好照片面前，时间流速不一样。

text.en: A full minute. This section earned it.
text.zh: 整整一分钟，这版块担得起。

text.en: Deep in the itinerary? Take your time.
text.zh: 研究行程呢？慢慢来。

text.en: The map dots are patient company.
text.zh: 地图上的点很有耐心陪着你。

text.en: Are you planning your own trip? I'm watching.
text.zh: 在参考行程规划自己的旅行？我注意到了。

text.en: I'm not bored. I'm on standby.
text.zh: 我不是无聊，我是在待机。

text.en: The photos are not going anywhere. Neither are you.
text.zh: 照片不会跑，你也不会跑。

text.en: One minute of quiet appreciation. Fair.
text.zh: 一分钟的安静欣赏，合理的。

text.en: I thought you left. But here you still are.
text.zh: 我以为你走了，但你还在。

text.en: The gallery deserved more than that.
text.zh: 图库值得你多停留一会儿。

text.en: Scrolling past travel photos at speed. Brave.
text.zh: 快速翻过旅行照片，挺大胆的。

text.en: Those photos were taken slowly. Just saying.
text.zh: 那些照片是慢慢拍的，仅供参考。

text.en: The itinerary went by in a blur. Intentional?
text.zh: 行程表一下就翻过去了，是故意的？

text.en: Fast scroll on a slow-travel site.
text.zh: 快速划过慢旅行网站，已记录。

text.en: The photos only had time to blink at you.
text.zh: 照片只来得及眨个眼。

text.en: Speed-running a photography portfolio.
text.zh: 速通摄影作品集模式已开启。

text.en: Shot at 1/4000s. You scrolled faster.
text.zh: 快门 1/4000s，你滑得比快门还快。

text.en: You scrolled all the way. Daniel approves.
text.zh: 你翻到底了，Daniel 会满意的。

text.en: Bottom of the portfolio. Very thorough.
text.zh: 到了作品集底部，很认真。

text.en: The itinerary ends here. The trip doesn't.
text.zh: 行程表到底了，旅途还没结束。

text.en: Full scroll. Commitment to the work.
text.zh: 翻到底了，对作品的尊重到位了。

text.en: Checked everything. Very organized.
text.zh: 全部看了一遍，很有条理。

text.en: Explorer mode: complete.
text.zh: 探索模式：完成。

text.en: Nothing missed. Good.
text.zh: 没有遗漏，不错。

text.en: End of page. Start of wherever this takes you.
text.zh: 页面结束，旅途开始。

text.en: The filter button received your enthusiasm.
text.zh: 筛选按钮收到你的热情了。

text.en: Category selected. Re-selected. Re-re-selected.
text.zh: 已选类别。重新选择。再次重新选择。

text.en: That map marker is popular today.
text.zh: 那个地图标记今天很受欢迎。

text.en: Bold clicking energy on the photo filters.
text.zh: 在照片筛选器上点击得很有气势。

text.en: The ALL filter is feeling very appreciated.
text.zh: ALL 筛选项感受到被重视了。

text.en: Curiosity metric: very high.
text.zh: 好奇心指数：很高。

text.en: The button heard you the first time.
text.zh: 按钮第一次就听见了。

text.en: Click again and the map might feel special.
text.zh: 再点一下地图要觉得自己与众不同了。

text.en: VIEW WORK is being evaluated. It can feel it.
text.zh: VIEW WORK 正在被你审视，它感受到了。

text.en: The gallery button is holding its breath.
text.zh: 图库按钮在屏住呼吸。

text.en: One click from the photography section.
text.zh: 离摄影版块只差一次点击。

text.en: TRAVEL is calling. You're almost there.
text.zh: TRAVEL 在召唤你，快了。

text.en: Hesitation before beauty. Classic.
text.zh: 在美面前犹豫，经典。

text.en: That button knows something good is on the other side.
text.zh: 那个按钮知道对面有好东西。

text.en: Almost clicked. The suspense is exquisite.
text.zh: 差点就点了，悬念拿捏得很好。

text.en: The travel section is very ready for you.
text.zh: 旅行版块已经准备好迎接你了。

text.en: Photography is the most expensive free hobby.
text.zh: 摄影是最贵的免费爱好。

text.en: A Sony A7R2 and a plane ticket. Reasonable expenses.
text.zh: 一台 A7R2 加机票，合理的支出。

text.en: Some investments are just memories you buy early.
text.zh: 有些投资只是提前购买的回忆。

text.en: Travel budgets are just wishes with numbers attached.
text.zh: 旅行预算不过是带数字的愿望清单。

text.en: The best shots usually cost a long flight.
text.zh: 最好的照片往往要坐一趟长途飞机。

text.en: Camera gear or plane tickets. Why not both.
text.zh: 相机配件还是机票，为什么不能都要。

text.en: The ROI on good travel photography is immeasurable.
text.zh: 好的旅行摄影回报率无法计算。

text.en: Every photo here is a receipt for a great moment.
text.zh: 这里每张照片都是一个美好时刻的收据。

text.en: Questions about the trip? The itinerary section answers most.
text.zh: 关于旅行有疑问？行程版块大多都有答案。

text.en: The map shows where. The travel section shows when and why.
text.zh: 地图告诉你去哪，旅行版块告诉你何时去和为什么。

text.en: Curious about the camera? Sony A7R2. Film and digital.
text.zh: 好奇用什么相机？A7R2，胶片加数码。

text.en: Where were these taken? The map has all of them.
text.zh: 这些在哪里拍的？地图上全都有标注。

text.en: The photography section is very self-explanatory.
text.zh: 摄影版块是能自我解释的那种。

text.en: Travel questions answered by the itinerary. Usually.
text.zh: 关于旅行的问题，行程基本都能回答。

text.en: The photos explain themselves better than I could.
text.zh: 照片比我解释得好多了。

text.en: Ask the map. It knows more than it lets on.
text.zh: 问问地图，它懂的比看起来多。

text.en: Searching for a destination? Take your time.
text.zh: 在找目的地？慢慢来。

text.en: The trip selector is ready when you are.
text.zh: 行程选择器准备好了，等你。

text.en: So many trips, so little cursor movement.
text.zh: 这么多行程，光标却迟迟不动。

text.en: A thoughtful pause before choosing a destination.
text.zh: 选目的地前的谨慎停顿，很正常。

text.en: The map has no judgment. Wherever calls to you.
text.zh: 地图没有评判，哪里召唤你就去哪里。

text.en: Paris or Tokyo? The hardest question.
text.zh: 巴黎还是东京？最难的问题。

text.en: The itinerary has strong opinions. Let it guide you.
text.zh: 行程表很有主见，让它带路吧。

text.en: Pick a trip. Any trip. They're all real.
text.zh: 选一个行程，随便哪个，都是真实走过的。

text.en: Welcome back. Did Google Maps have better photos?
text.zh: 回来了，Google Maps 上的照片更好看？

text.en: Back from comparison-shopping destinations?
text.zh: 从对比目的地的标签页回来了？

text.en: I kept the gallery warm while you were away.
text.zh: 你不在的时候，我帮你把图库看守住了。

text.en: Tab return detected. The map missed you.
text.zh: 检测到回到标签页，地图想你了。

text.en: I definitely was not waiting for your return.
text.zh: 我绝对不是在等你回来。

text.en: Paris or Tokyo research on another tab?
text.zh: 刚才在别的标签页研究巴黎还是东京？

text.en: Good timing. I was pretending to be busy.
text.zh: 回来得正好，我刚在假装很忙。

text.en: The itinerary waited. Patiently.
text.zh: 行程表等着你呢，很有耐心。

text.en: Leaving already? The travel section hasn't landed yet.
text.zh: 这就走了？旅行版块还没来得及落地。

text.en: One more photo before you go?
text.zh: 走之前再看一张？

text.en: The Paris itinerary will be here when you return.
text.zh: 巴黎行程会等你回来的。

text.en: The map pins will hold your place.
text.zh: 地图上的点会帮你留着位置。

text.en: A photographer's work deserves more than one visit.
text.zh: 摄影师的作品值得不止一次拜访。

text.en: Saving the travel section for next time?
text.zh: 旅行版块留到下次？

text.en: Exit detected. The gallery objects slightly.
text.zh: 检测到退出，图库有一点点意见。

text.en: You were here. The photos will remember.
text.zh: 你来过了，照片会记得的。

text.en: The map marker had a moment.
text.zh: 地图标记刚才短暂失联了。

text.en: Photos load at their own pace sometimes.
text.zh: 照片有时候按自己的节奏加载。

text.en: Small glitch. The itinerary is fine.
text.zh: 小波动，行程没问题。

text.en: The filter had a brief identity crisis.
text.zh: 筛选器刚才短暂迷失自我了。

text.en: Not a bug. A candid moment.
text.zh: 不是 bug，是一个抓拍瞬间。

text.en: Let's call that a rehearsal.
text.zh: 我们就当刚才是彩排。

text.en: Technology blinked. Daniel's photos did not.
text.zh: 技术眨了个眼，Daniel 的照片没眨。

text.en: A retry may be less dramatic.
text.zh: 再试一次，可能会低调很多。

text.en: Reading the day-by-day itinerary. Smart.
text.zh: 在看每日行程，聪明的旅行者。

text.en: The travel notes are worth the slow read.
text.zh: 旅行笔记值得细读。

text.en: Taking notes on the Paris day plan?
text.zh: 在记巴黎每日计划？

text.en: Good itineraries deserve good readers.
text.zh: 好行程需要认真的读者。

text.en: Careful reading detected. The trip will go well.
text.zh: 检测到认真阅读，这趟旅行一定顺利。

text.en: I'll wait while the itinerary does its work.
text.zh: 我先等着，让行程发挥作用。

text.en: Not skimming. Actually reading. Respect.
text.zh: 不是扫一眼，是真的在读，尊重。

text.en: Restaurant recommendations deserve this attention.
text.zh: 餐厅推荐值得这种重视。

text.en: The dark aesthetic is doing something.
text.zh: 这个暗调美学确实有效果。

text.en: Gold on black. Daniel has opinions about contrast.
text.zh: 黑底金色，Daniel 对对比度有自己的想法。

text.en: Film and digital in the same portfolio. Confident.
text.zh: 胶片和数码同一个作品集，很有自信。

text.en: Somewhere a Sony A7R2 is missing being used.
text.zh: 不知道哪里有台 A7R2 想被拿出来用。

text.en: Every photo here has a weather story behind it.
text.zh: 这里每张照片背后都有一段天气故事。

text.en: Travel photography: making people want to book flights.
text.zh: 旅行摄影：让人想立刻去订机票。

text.en: I have no agenda. I just appreciate good composition.
text.zh: 我没有目的，只是欣赏好构图。

text.en: The map has more stories than the dots suggest.
text.zh: 地图上的点比看起来藏着更多故事。

text.en: The gallery. Sony A7R2 in full effect.
text.zh: 图库，A7R2 的主场。

text.en: Film and digital side by side. Quite a collection.
text.zh: 胶片与数码并列，这个系列有分量。

text.en: PEOPLE · CITY · NATURE · TIME. Pick your mood.
text.zh: PEOPLE · CITY · NATURE · TIME，选一个心情。

text.en: These shots were chosen carefully. Slow down.
text.zh: 这些照片都是精选过的，慢一点看。

text.en: Photography section. I'll be quiet.
text.zh: 摄影版块，我先安静一下。

text.en: The light in these photos has opinions.
text.zh: 这些照片里的光线，是有想法的。

text.en: Good eye required. You brought yours.
text.zh: 需要好眼力，你带来了。

text.en: People shots or city shots — both have their reasons.
text.zh: 人文还是城市，两种都有说法。

text.en: Every dot is a real place Daniel stood with a camera.
text.zh: 每个点都是 Daniel 真实驻足过的地方。

text.en: Photo locations mapped. This is how trips become stories.
text.zh: 拍摄地点已标注，这就是旅行变成故事的方式。

text.en: The map knows where the light was good.
text.zh: 地图知道哪里的光线最好。

text.en: Click a dot. Find where the photo was taken.
text.zh: 点一个标记，发现拍摄地。

text.en: Geography and photography, intertwined here.
text.zh: 地理与摄影，在这里交织在一起。

text.en: Where in the world was the A7R2?
text.zh: A7R2 曾经去过哪里？

text.en: The map is a different way to see the gallery.
text.zh: 地图是看图库的另一种方式。

text.en: Each marker is a moment that got preserved.
text.zh: 每个标记都是一个被留住的瞬间。

text.en: Trip itineraries, publicly shared. Generous.
text.zh: 行程公开分享，大方。

text.en: Day-by-day planning, all visible. Rare.
text.zh: 每日计划全部公开，难得。

text.en: Someone planned these trips very carefully.
text.zh: 这些行程是认真规划过的。

text.en: Itinerary browsing mode activated.
text.zh: 行程浏览模式开启。

text.en: Each trip card is a compressed story.
text.zh: 每个行程卡片都是一段故事的压缩版。

text.en: Real trip plans. You could recreate this.
text.zh: 真实的旅行计划，你可以照着来一遍。

text.en: The Paris itinerary is in here somewhere.
text.zh: 巴黎行程就在这里。

text.en: Travel notes from someone who actually went.
text.zh: 来自真正去过的人的旅行笔记。

text.en: That spot. Good taste.
text.zh: 那个地点，眼光不错。

text.en: Photo location found. The shot was worth the trip.
text.zh: 找到拍摄地了，这张照片值那趟旅程。

text.en: Click. Story unlocked.
text.zh: 点击，故事解锁。

text.en: That frame was perfect at exactly that spot.
text.zh: 就在那个位置，那个画面是完美的。

text.en: You found where the photo lives.
text.zh: 你找到照片住的地方了。

text.en: Location marked. Memory attached.
text.zh: 位置已标记，记忆已附上。

text.en: The camera was here. Now you are too.
text.zh: 相机在这里站过，现在轮到你了。

text.en: Good spot. The A7R2 agreed at the time.
text.zh: 好地方，A7R2 当时也认可了。
